status: RATIFIED 2026-08-18 (retrofit, Decision 1). Phase state lives in ROADMAP.md only.

survey.what_is_it: a command-line tool that converts Substack articles into clean, formatted PDFs (metadata, full body, high-res embedded images, captions, code blocks, linked footnotes); free posts from a URL, paywalled posts via the user's own cookies or a saved HTML page. Evolving toward a core library with CLI/MCP/GUI interfaces and pluggable per-platform adapters (see README, docs/architecture.png).

architecture_rung.earned_by: a single deterministic pipeline, human-run. No parallelizable, independently-verifiable seams yet; rung 2 would be earned by a resident verifier over the (not-yet-built) fixture goldens. Confirmed by the human at retrofit.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: the entire conversion pipeline — HTML fetch, DOM extraction/cleaning, best-resolution image embedding, footnote linking, paywall-truncation detection, and PDF rendering. Pure reproducible Python; no model in the path.

oracle_shape.goldens: planned: saved-HTML fixtures asserting body-char floor, no trailing divider, no false paywall warning, footnote/image counts (ROADMAP Phase 0). Current: py_compile smoke + kit gates.
oracle_shape.ci: verify fast on ubuntu (public repo — unlimited Actions minutes)

lifespan_autonomy.lifespan: long-lived personal tool, actively developed toward the library/MCP/GUI roadmap
lifespan_autonomy.autonomy_tier: human-run; no unattended operation. Public repo; pushes and any public release are the human's.
